newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 21.915 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 21.915 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Thursday, July 3, was fixed at 21.9150 percent, or 26 basis points lower than the previous day's rate of 22.1750 percent, Banco de Mexico said on Wednesday

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Wednesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
The weekly revised 91-day TIIE rate fell 122 basis points to 21.2250 percent on Wednesday from 22.4450 percent the week before.
The 28-day TIIP rate, also revised weekly, fell 103.05 basis points to 21.9358 percent on Wednesday from 22.9663 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
